{{Top|leg}}
The '''Montitians''' were the natives of the planet [[Montitia]]. They were evacuated by [[Charza Kwinn]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[Montitian Extraction]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial period]], their homeworld was inhabited again. They were often recruited to work on the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] world of [[Duroon]]. Once there, however, the promised jobs turned out to be a position of near-slavery, and they were forced to mine the planet's vast resources alongside other indentured alien species.
